हृणिया f. (-या)
 1. Shame, modesty.
 2. Censure, reproach.
 3. Pity. E.
[]
हृणीङ् Kaṇḍwādi root, to be ashamed, यक् aff., and the vowel
made short; otherwise read हृणीया ।

हृणीया f. (-या)
 1. Censure, reproach.
 2. Shame, bashfulness.
 3. Pity. E.
हृणीय, अ aff.: see हृणिया; also read ह्रिणीया ।

हृणी (हृणीयते) To feel ashamed. A kaṇḍwādi root; य is always added
on the base in the case of this root: see ह्रिणी ।
